infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: StrictlyFuel uses the camera to photograph your meal or a product label so it can estimate the nutrition.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: StrictlyFuel needs access to your photos so you can pick an existing meal photo to analyse.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: StrictlyFuel saves the fuel cards you create to your photo library when you ask it to.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: StrictlyFuel reads workouts you choose to share so it can help you repeat and fuel similar sessions.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: StrictlyFuel only reads workouts you choose to share and does not write data to Apple Health.
